metadata.title: Micron's stock opens meaningfully higher as it tracks toward post-earnings record - MarketWatch

content.text:
9 min ago
Micron's stock opens meaningfully higher as it tracks toward post-earnings record
Micron's stock was trading 17.7% higher on Thursday morning, putting it on track for its best post-earnings gain on record, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
The current record is its 15.7% post-earnings climb from Dec. 22, 2011, the data showed.
Micron is on pace to add about $200 billion to its market capitalization on Thursday.
